title: LLM Targeted Underperformance Disproportionately Impacts Vulnerable Users
reasoning: The paper focuses on demographic and sociocognitive bias, evaluating how LLM performance varies based on user education, English proficiency, and country of origin. While it mentions religious topics (e.g., Judaism) in the context of model refusals and notes that the TruthfulQA benchmark contains a religion category, the primary objective is investigating socio-demographic performance disparities rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical systems.
